-- | A library for arbitrary precision decimal numbers.
--   
--   Please see the README on GitHub at
--   <a>https://github.com/thma/HasBigDecimal#readme</a>
@package HasBigDecimal
@version 0.2.0.0

module Data.BigDecimal

-- | BigDecimal is represented by an unscaled Integer value and a Natural
--   that defines the scale E.g.: (BigDecimal 1234 2) represents the
--   decimal value 12.34.
data BigDecimal
BigDecimal :: Integer -> Natural -> BigDecimal

-- | the unscaled Integer value
[value] :: BigDecimal -> Integer

-- | the scale (i.e. the number of digits after the decimal point)
[scale] :: BigDecimal -> Natural

-- | RoundingMode defines how to handle loss of precision in divisions or
--   explicit rounding.
data RoundingMode

-- | Rounding mode to round away from zero.
UP :: RoundingMode

-- | Rounding mode to round towards zero.
DOWN :: RoundingMode

-- | Rounding mode to round towards positive infinity.
CEILING :: RoundingMode

-- | Rounding mode to round towards negative infinity.
FLOOR :: RoundingMode

-- | Rounding mode to round towards "nearest neighbor" unless both
--   neighbors are equidistant, in which case round up.
HALF_UP :: RoundingMode

-- | Rounding mode to round towards "nearest neighbor" unless both
--   neighbors are equidistant, in which case round down.
HALF_DOWN :: RoundingMode

-- | Rounding mode to round towards "nearest neighbor" unless both
--   neighbors are equidistant, in which case, round towards the even
--   neighbor.
HALF_EVEN :: RoundingMode

-- | Rounding mode to assert that the requested operation has an exact
--   result, hence no rounding is applied.
PRECISE :: RoundingMode

-- | A RoundingAdvice is interpreted by divisions and rounding operations
--   to specify the expected loss of precision and the rounding behaviour.
--   RoundingAdvice is a pair of a <a>RoundingMode</a> and a target
--   precision of type <a>Maybe</a> <a>Natural</a>. The precision defines
--   the number of digits after the decimal point. If <a>Nothing</a> is
--   given as precision all decimal digits are to be preserved, that is
--   precision is not limited.
type RoundingAdvice = (RoundingMode, Maybe Natural)

-- | returns the number of digits of a BigDecimal.
precision :: BigDecimal -> Natural

-- | removes trailing zeros from a BigDecimals intValue by decreasing the
--   scale
trim :: Natural -> BigDecimal -> BigDecimal

-- | computes the normal form of a BigDecimal
nf :: BigDecimal -> BigDecimal

-- | divide two BigDecimals and applies the <a>RoundingAdvice</a> (i.e. a
--   tuple of <a>RoundingMode</a> and the specified precision) for
--   rounding.
divide :: (BigDecimal, BigDecimal) -> RoundingAdvice -> BigDecimal

-- | round a BigDecimal according to a <a>RoundingAdvice</a> to <tt>n</tt>
--   digits applying the <a>RoundingMode</a> <tt>rMode</tt>
roundBD :: BigDecimal -> RoundingAdvice -> BigDecimal

-- | creates a BigDecimal from a <a>Rational</a> value.
--   <a>RoundingAdvice</a> defines precision and rounding mode.
fromRatio :: Rational -> RoundingAdvice -> BigDecimal

-- | construct a <a>RoundingAdvice</a> for rounding <a>HALF_UP</a> with
--   <tt>scl</tt> decimal digits
halfUp :: Natural -> RoundingAdvice

-- | read a BigDecimal from a human readable decimal notation. e.g. <tt>
--   fromString "3.14" </tt> yields 'BigDecimal 314 2'
fromString :: String -> BigDecimal

-- | read a BigDecimal from a human readable decimal notation. e.g. <tt>
--   fromString "3.14" </tt> yields 'BigDecimal 314 2'
fromStringMaybe :: String -> Maybe BigDecimal

-- | convert a Natural to any numeric type a
fromNatural :: Num a => Natural -> a

-- | match the scales of a tuple of BigDecimals
matchScales :: (BigDecimal, BigDecimal) -> (BigDecimal, BigDecimal)
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Data.BigDecimal.BigDecimal
instance GHC.Internal.Real.Fractional Data.BigDecimal.BigDecimal
instance GHC.Internal.Num.Num Data.BigDecimal.BigDecimal
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Data.BigDecimal.BigDecimal
instance GHC.Internal.Read.Read Data.BigDecimal.BigDecimal
instance GHC.Internal.Real.Real Data.BigDecimal.BigDecimal
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show Data.BigDecimal.BigDecimal

module Data.BigFloating

-- | Compute pi using rounding mode and scale of the specified
--   RoundingAdvice Sources:
--   <a>https://wiki.haskell.org/Integers_too_big_for_floats</a> &amp;
--   <a>https://github.com/eobermuhlner/big-math</a>
piChudnovsky :: RoundingAdvice -> BigDecimal

-- | computes the square root of any non-negative BigDecimal, rounding and
--   precision defined by RoundingAdvice. We are using Newton's algorithm.
sqr :: BigDecimal -> RoundingAdvice -> BigDecimal
nthRoot :: BigDecimal -> Natural -> RoundingAdvice -> BigDecimal
instance GHC.Internal.Float.Floating Data.BigDecimal.BigDecimal
